quote.quote_id: Stable ID: 'Q' + first 12 hex chars of sha256(source_id|article_url|quote_text).
quote.quote_text: Exact text from the article, as stored in articles.text[char_start:char_end].
quote.extraction_date: When the quote was saved, ISO 8601 UTC.
quote.speaker: Person or body quoted, if any.
quote.rationale: Why the model proposed the passage.
quote.char_start: Start offset in the stored article text.
quote.char_end: End offset in the stored article text.
quote.article_text_sha256: sha256 of the stored article text the offsets refer to.
quote.verification: Result of every deterministic check (all true for stored quotes).
